```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
library(kableExtra)
options(modelsummary_factory_latex = "kableExtra")
options(modelsummary_factory_html = "kableExtra")
```

# データの読み込みと準備

## 共通設定

```{r settings}
# 分析対象の年次
keep_years <- seq(2010, 2020, by = 2)
# 高所得EU諸国のリスト（対照群と英国）
EU_HI <- c("AUT", "BEL", "DNK", "FIN", "FRA", "DEU", "IRL", "ITA", "LUX", "NLD", "SWE", "GBR")
# 表示用の係数名のマッピング
cm <- c(
  "UK"             = "UK",
  "Post_Referendum" = "Post-Referendum",
  "UK:Post_Referendum" = "UK x Post-Referendum"
)
```

## 現地法人レベルパネル

```{r load-affiliate}
df_affiliate <- import("../../03_data_output/Affiliate/affiliate_panel_brexit_high_income_eu_sample.dta") %>%
  filter(country %in% EU_HI, year %in% keep_years) %>%
  mutate(
    UK              = as.integer(country == "GBR"),
    Post_Referendum = as.integer(year >= 2016)
  )
```

# 現地法人レベルの分析

## 推定

```{r estimation-affiliate}
# (1) 退出ダミー（法人固定効果・年固定効果、国レベルクラスタリング）
res_exit_affiliate <- feols(
  exitit ~ UK:Post_Referendum | AffiliateCode + year,
  data = df_affiliate,
  vcov = ~country
)

# (2) 出資比率（法人固定効果・年固定効果、国レベルクラスタリング）
res_ratio_affiliate <- feols(
  Ratio ~ UK:Post_Referendum | AffiliateCode + year,
  data = df_affiliate,
  vcov = ~country
)
```

## 結果の表示

```{r summary-affiliate}
models_affiliate <- list(
  "Exit Dummy"      = res_exit_affiliate,
  "Ownership Ratio" = res_ratio_affiliate
)

modelsummary(models_affiliate,
             output = "markdown",
             stars = TRUE,
             fmt = 3,
             gof_omit = "Log.Lik.|Pseudo.R2|AIC|BIC",
             coef_map = cm)
```
